debtor_exclusion.action: candidates resolving to the debtor are discarded before scoring; a debtor transmitter is rendered as the @DEBTOR sentinel; assert_debtor_excluded() fails the run if violated
debtor_exclusion.rationale: the debtor is never a creditor - and not the other way round either (thesis decision 3). Structural, not left to model judgement.

text_recovery.rationale: a page with fewer than 25 characters in its text layer is treated as a scan; OCR below 0.80 mean confidence -> RECUPERARE (A.1)

rules.regex: (no dissent on the merits|nessun dissenso nel merito|however|tuttavia|si segnala|for the record|per completezza)

dissent_nature.rationale: L6: not every non-empty field is a dispute

owners.rationale: who owns outgoing documents per area (L2 scanner groups findings by owner)

scanner_guards.rationale: L2 precision guards: context, snapshots, comparisons, owner closure

staleness.rationale: L4: nightly cadence + 2h grace; older data is flagged STALE
